description: This file implements a role selector engine for accessibility testing, including functions for validating ARIA roles and attributes, querying elements by role, and creating a selector engine.

methods.name: validateSupportedRole
methods.description: Validates if a role is supported for a given ARIA attribute.

methods.name: validateSupportedValues
methods.description: Checks if the attribute value is within the supported values.

methods.name: validateSupportedOp
methods.description: Checks if the attribute operator is supported.

methods.name: validateAttributes
methods.description: Validates and constructs role-related options from attribute selectors.

methods.name: queryRole
methods.description: Queries elements matching specified ARIA role and attribute options within a scope.
